title: Payment Method Rate on Optional Coverage Add-Ons Premium Corrections
content:
A corrected autopay rate is added to the corrected discount rate used for the premium billing correction of an Optional Coverage Add-Ons rider, according to how the latest premium payment on the base Homeowner Service Contracts contract was made, as that contract's billing history records it:

| Payment method of the latest premium payment on the base homeowner contract | Corrected autopay rate added |
|---|---|
| ach | 0.02 (2 percent) |
| card | 0.01 (1 percent) |
| Any other method, or no such payment | None |
| The rider's base is not a homeowner contract | None |

Only the latest premium payment on the rider's own base homeowner contract is read; an earlier payment made by another method, or a payment on another contract, does not change the rate.

**Hypothetical cases.**

- The latest premium payment on the base homeowner contract was made by card, and the one before it by ach: 0.01 is added.
- The latest premium payment on the base homeowner contract was made by a method other than ach or card: nothing is added.
- A rider on a rental property service contract: nothing is added.
